=== platform/flux-system/flux-system-kustomization-platform.yaml ===
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: platform
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  dependsOn:
  - name: shop-db
  - name: external
  healthChecks:
  - apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
    kind: Kustomization
    name: shop-db
    namespace: flux-system
  - apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
    kind: Kustomization
    name: shop-api
    namespace: flux-system
  interval: 1h0m0s
  path: platform/platform
  prune: false
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
    namespace: flux-system
=== platform/flux-system/flux-system-kustomization-shop-api.yaml ===
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: shop-api
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  dependsOn:
  - name: shop-db
  interval: 1h0m0s
  path: platform/platform/shop-api
  prune: false
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
    namespace: flux-system
=== platform/flux-system/flux-system-kustomization-shop-db.yaml ===
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: shop-db
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 1h0m0s
  path: platform/platform/shop-db
  prune: false
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
    namespace: flux-system
=== platform/flux-system/kustomization.yaml ===
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - flux-system-kustomization-platform.yaml
  - flux-system-kustomization-shop-api.yaml
  - flux-system-kustomization-shop-db.yaml
=== platform/kustomization.yaml ===
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - flux-system
=== platform/platform/default-configmap-monitoring-app-cm.yaml ===
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: monitoring-app-cm
  namespace: default
=== platform/platform/default-configmap-platform-app-cm.yaml ===
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: platform-app-cm
  namespace: default
=== platform/platform/default-configmap-shop-app-cm.yaml ===

  name: shop-app-cm
  namespace: default
=== platform/platform/kustomization.yaml ===

  - default-configmap-shop-app-cm.yaml
